item.title: Show HN: Claude-account now works on macOS too
item.summary: A few days ago, I shared claude-account here. I received far more feedback and support than I expected, so thank you to everyone who commented, tested it, and contributed. The most requested update was macOS support. So it now works on both Linux and macOS. You can add your work and personal Claude Code accounts once, then switch between them with a simple command without logging in again. Thank you again for helping me improve it. https://github.com/hamzarehmandeveloper/claude-account Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49181478 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
